description: A Claude Code 2.1.327 transcript with a tools-used entry listing the tools the session has used.
note: Claude Code's transcript serializer is not published, and the pinned release notes do not mention this entry; the changelog link identifies the release. The matching Agent SDK 0.3.327 (claudeCodeVersion 2.1.327) reads {type: tools-used, sessionId, tools} from a transcript, keeping the string names, and writes the same entry into a forked session's transcript in sdk.mjs. The entry is a list of tool names, not a record of any call.
